pipelines.name: basebuild
findings: [CRITICAL] NO_TEST_GATE: CRITICAL: Job 'goreleaser' performs deployment without upstream test gates ('needs:' block is empty).
[HIGH] UNFILTERED_MAIN_PUSH: Deployment workflow triggers on 'push' without branch or tag filters.
[HIGH] UNPINNED_ACTION: Job 'goreleaser' step 7 uses unpinned action 'goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
[HIGH] EXCESSIVE_PERMISSIONS: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
[LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'goreleaser' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

anti_patterns.message: CRITICAL: Job 'goreleaser' performs deployment without upstream test gates ('needs:' block is empty).
anti_patterns.remediation: Add a 'needs:' dependency on a test or verification job before executing deployment steps.

anti_patterns.message: Deployment workflow triggers on 'push' without branch or tag filters.
anti_patterns.remediation: Restrict push triggers using explicit 'branches:' or 'tags:' allowlists (for example, branches: [main]).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'goreleaser' step 7 uses unpinned action 'goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

anti_patterns.message: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
anti_patterns.remediation: Declare explicit least-privilege 'permissions:' (for example, contents: read) at the workflow or job level.
Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).
